name: Bergbauern-Käse Workshop
beschreibung:
### Overview
Tyrol's alpine dairies look back on centuries of artisanal cheese-making fueled by fragrant mountain pastures and silage-free hay milk. Through cheese-making workshops and show dairies, visitors discover the craft firsthand: from copper kettle heating to the production of PDO-protected Tiroler Almkäse and Tiroler Graukäse, the leanest traditional cheese in the Alps. Guided by master cheese-makers, guests explore natural fermentation, rennet curdling, and aging techniques.

### Route & Requirements
Guests can choose between hands-on make-your-own-cheese workshops (such as at Almschule Tirol in Aschau, Zillertal), where participants heat fresh milk, cut the curd with a cheese harp, and press an individual wheel with alpine herbs, and touring prominent visitor show dairies. Major visitor dairies include the ErlebnisSennerei Zillertal in Mayrhofen, featuring panoramic glass viewing galleries of morning vat production (08:00–12:00), aging cellars, and cheese tasting stations (€17.90 adults, €8.90 children, under 7s free). In the Kitzbühel Alps, the mountain dairy Kasplatzl on the Hintenbachalm (1,100 m in Kirchberg) conducts weekly guided cheese tours (~€11.50 incl. tastings). Further renowned stops include the Schönangeralm in Wildschönau, the Wilder Käser in Kirchdorf, and the historic Eng Alm at Großer Ahornboden. Valley dairies operate year-round, while high alpine pasture dairies welcome visitors from May/June to October. Very family-friendly, though dogs are not permitted in cheese production areas due to strict hygiene rules.

### Getting There
ErlebnisSennerei Mayrhofen: Take the Zillertalbahn railway to Mayrhofen, then take local transit to Hollenzen. Free customer parking on-site. Kasplatzl Kirchberg: Reachable via the scenic Aschau toll road into Spertental.

### Tips
Fresh batch curdling and vat stirring take place primarily between 08:00 and 12:00 in the morning, making early arrival advisable. ErlebnisSennerei Zillertal features a pet-and-play petting farm with goats, playground towers, and yoghurt tasting bars. Fully stroller accessible. Sample local Graukäse marinated with vinegar, pumpkin seed oil, and sliced red onions.
